name: sx-turnover-tax
description: Sint Maarten turnover tax (omzetbelasting, belasting op bedrijfsomzetten) for 2026 under the Turnover Tax Ordinance in force from 12 April 2023. Covers who is an entrepreneur, the 5% rate on turnover realised in Sint Maarten, the exclusion of genuine disbursements, receipt-based timing and invoice accounting on authorisation, the article 8 exemptions (including residential rent, hotel rooms under room tax, listed basic goods, medical, transport, casinos, financial dealings), the article 9 export exemption where the French side counts as inside the levy area and its evidence rules, recipient liability for overseas suppliers on request, and monthly returns and payment within 15 days. Applies to Dutch Sint Maarten. Trigger phrases include Sint Maarten turnover tax, TOT Sint Maarten, BBO Sint Maarten, omzetbelasting St. Maarten, 5% turnover tax.
